columns.name: genretype
columns.description: The genre type of the work.

columns.name: num_characters
columns.description: The number of characters in the work, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_scenes
columns.description: The number of scenes in the work, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_a_character_as_a_Third_Servingman
columns.description: Set to 1 if the work has  a character as a "Third Servingman", otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: is_one_act_work
columns.description: Set to 1 if the work is a one-act work, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: average_scene_per_act
columns.description: The average number of scenes per act in the work.

config:

  config:
    mongodb_definition_id: b2e713cd-cc36-4c0a-b5bd-b47cb8a0561e

aws_s3:

  AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-west-2
  AWS_ENDPOINT_URL: http://elt-localstack:4566
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: test

    sync_mode: full_refresh_append

custom_api:
  config:
    configuration: {}
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append

  config:
    connection_string: mongodb://elt-mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true

    - characters
postgres:
  config:
    database: shakespeare
    host: elt-postgres
    password: testelt
    port: 5432
    schema: public
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - paragraphs
    user: postgres
redshift:
  config:
    host: <redshift_hostname>
    port: <redshift_port>
    database: <redshift_db>
    username: <redshift_username>

    s3_bucket_name: <redshift_s3_bucket>
